open_questions: Official dated launch article is August 13, 2026; earlier HF repository creation is not treated as the launch date. The launch article says Global LLM initializes from Qwen3.5-8B, while the pinned checkpoint card says Qwen3-8B and its language-model config identifies Qwen3ForCausalLM. Checkpoint architecture follows config/card; initialization provenance conflict remains unresolved.
Resolve 32 kHz card/API output versus 44.1 kHz diffusers vocoder/condition-encoder configuration at this exact revision.
Card advertises five-minute songs but also lists 9000 acoustic frames and 25 frames/second; retain the capability statement and implementation cap separately.
No model-weight downloads, inference runs, quality evaluation or GPU-memory measurements were performed. Vendor runtime/memory examples are not independently validated.

metadata.name: MiniMax-Music3
metadata.license: MiniMax-Music3 Community License; see pinned LICENSE.
metadata.variant_policy: One released text-to-music pipeline: Global LLM + Local LLM + hidden-state fusion + Flow Matching + Flow-VAE decoder. Lyrics and music description are complementary text inputs; this record does not treat Music3 as a general chat LLM or a TTS voice-cloning model.

generation.objective: Hierarchical autoregressive RVQ-codebook prediction plus continuous hidden-state synthesis using Flow Matching and Flow-VAE.
generation.scheduler: FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler: shift=1.0, invert_sigmas=true, use_dynamic_shifting=false, stochastic_sampling=false; num_train_timesteps=1 is a config value and does not establish the training budget or universal inference-step count.
generation.sampling: Card example uses seed=7 and max_new_tokens=750 acoustic frames; each frame represents 1/25 second, with early termination at end-of-audio. A separate diffusers example requests audio_duration=60.0.

architecture.backbone: Hierarchical Hybrid-LM: Qwen3-8B-initialized Global LLM predicts first RVQ codebook frame by frame; 0.6B Local LLM predicts remaining codebooks within a frame. Hidden-state fusion conditions a 2.4B flow-matching synthesis model and 123M Flow-VAE decoder. Global config: 36 layers, hidden=4096, FFN=12288, vocab=200000, max_position_embeddings=10240. Local config: 4 layers, hidden=4096, 8 codebooks. Synthesis transformer: 36 layers, 32 heads, head_dim=64, in_channels=128.
architecture.parameters: Component counts from card: Global LLM 8B; Local LLM 0.6B; Flow Matching 2.4B; Flow-VAE decoder 123M. A complete unique-parameter accounting for the full pipeline is not supplied.
architecture.attention: Global LLM: full attention in all 36 layers, 32 query heads /8 KV heads, head_dim=128, RoPE theta=1000000. Synthesis model: 32 attention heads, head_dim=64, rotary_dim=32.
architecture.conditioning: Lyrics with section tags define sung words and song structure; music description provides genre, emotion, vocal performance, instruments, arrangement and production. Fused final Global/Local hidden states condition the flow-matching path.
architecture.vae: Flow-VAE adapted from MiniMax Speech and retrained for music; card reports 123M decoder. Released vocoder config: latent_channels=128, decoder_hidden_dim=1536, upsampling_ratios=[8,8,4,2].
architecture.audio_codec: Training uses 8-layer RVQ: first semantic codebook has 16384 entries, remaining 7 acoustic codebooks have 1024 each. Semantic codebook is trained first, then all codebooks jointly. Inference waveform synthesis uses fused continuous hidden states rather than the discrete tokenizer decoder.
architecture.multimodal_coupling: Text-conditioned music with expressive vocals and accompaniment in one audio output; no video generation or audio-reference conditioning is asserted by the registered card.
architecture.implementation: MiniMaxMusic3ForConditionalGeneration architecture; card provides SGLang-Omni shared /v1/audio/speech endpoint and a diffusers modular pipeline. Endpoint naming alone does not establish general speech synthesis support.

output.frame_rate: 25 acoustic frames/second (not a video frame rate)
output.duration: Up to five minutes per model card. The same card lists an implementation cap of 9000 acoustic frames; this cap and 25 frames/second must not be interpreted as a documented six-minute capability.
output.sample_rate: Card/API response: 32 kHz. Registered diffusers vocoder and condition-encoder configs specify 44100 Hz output; serving-path discrepancy is unresolved.

training.pretraining: Global LLM initializes from Qwen3-8B. Embedding and output layers are first adapted to semantic music tokens, then Global and Local LLMs are jointly trained on all RVQ codebooks. Flow-VAE is retrained for musical dynamics/spectral properties. Token/data totals, optimizer and training compute are undisclosed.

precision.weights: Global LLM config dtype=bfloat16; card loads modular pipeline components with torch.bfloat16. No claim that every stored tensor has this dtype.

artifacts: Global and Local LLM components, condition encoder, flow-matching transformer and Flow-VAE/vocoder configs and weights
Pinned public card, license and end-to-end inference example
limitations: Card limits tokenized text prompt to 5000 tokens and generation to 9000 acoustic frames.
The card/API sample rate (32000 Hz) differs from released diffusers vocoder/condition-encoder output settings (44100 Hz); this repository has not run either serving path.
